purpose: Design of document search: pre-search staleness judgment, the search result contract with the read-only search AI, and resolution of DLIDs to recorded paths.
summary: Pre-search check distinguishing rebuild not needed, rebuild needed and undeterminable
User choice between rebuilding before search or searching the existing version, with scale of rebuild shown
Target specification file written for reuse by index-docs and re-check via target-file
Undeterminable state is treated as a failure and never silently falls back to an old version
Search result contract: document ID, recorded path, reason, ToC key, version and freshness
Search AI reads all entries of the ToC copy and prioritizes avoiding false negatives
ToC copy contents: document info and section headings, without paths, hashes or references
resolve-dlid: resolving DLIDs to recorded paths verified against actual files, with content hash
Resolution outcomes: resolved, not at recorded path, no record; no writes to ToC or documents
tasks: Implementing query-docs and its pre-search check
Designing or reviewing the query-worker agent contract
title: DES-006 文書検索設計
